title: Shulchan Arukh Yoreh Deah — Wikisource English 133 (partial)
attribution: Shulchan Arukh by Joseph Karo with Rema glosses; English translations by Wikisource contributors. See source-manifest.json for pinned revisions and contributor histories. CC BY-SA 4.0.
changes: Selected paragraphs from one source revision, removed page navigation and interleaved Hebrew, and escaped text for the reader. Adapted text remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
scope: Selected English translations of Yoreh Deah 133:2, the first part of 133:3, and 133:6. Section 3 is explicitly partial: its second part is excluded because the source weakens a prohibition. The selection was compared with adjacent Hebrew and the local edition, but is not fully proofread; the source revision does not establish its translation method. Other sections are excluded.
